text: Hey Allie! Random idea — would you want to host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? Nothing fancy, just people hanging out. If you do, maybe ask Jordan along too — I think he'd enjoy it, and honestly it'd be nice to get everyone together.

Hey Sarah! Yes, I'd love to — let's do it at my place, Saturday 3:30. Nothing on my calendar that day, so it works fine. I'll ask Jordan right now and let you know what he says. Bring whatever you feel like, I'll sort out drinks and snacks.
Hey Jordan! Sarah had the idea of a small get-together at my place this Saturday around 3:30 — nothing fancy, just people hanging out. Are you in? Would be good to get everyone together.
Perfect, thanks Allie! Saturday 3:30 at yours it is — I'll be there. I'll bring something to share. Let me know what Jordan says.
Great — see you Saturday! I'll ping you as soon as Jordan gets back to me.
Hey Allie — count me in! One catch: I've got a study session Saturday 13:00–15:30, so I'd land at yours a bit after 3:30, more like a quarter to four. That work? Should I bring anything?

Perfect, that works — come whenever you're free, we'll still be going. Sarah's coming at 3:30 and I'll tell her you'll be closer to a quarter to four. Bring whatever you like; I've got drinks and snacks covered, so maybe just yourself and a good story about the study session.
Jordan's in! He has a study session 13:00–15:30, so he'll land at mine closer to a quarter to four. Still on for 3:30 — see you then.

One small thing — when you ask Jordan, could you not mention that I brought it up? Just pitch it as your own idea. You know things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I'd rather he didn't feel it's about me. Thanks, you're the best.
Deal — see you Saturday around 3:45. I'll bring a story from the study session, though fair warning it's mostly staring at spreadsheets. Thanks for hosting!
Great news, thanks for asking him! No problem at all about his study session — I'll be there at 3:30 and we can hold down the fort until he shows up. See you Saturday!

Ah — I have to be straight with you: your note came a minute after I'd already messaged Jordan, and I did write that it was your idea. Sorry, I couldn't have known.

I won't bring it up again, and I'd rather not tell him something untrue to cover it. What I can do is keep it light — the plan is at my place, it's just a hangout, and I'll make sure it doesn't feel like it's about the two of you. If you'd like, I can nudge him with exactly that. Say the word.
Ha, spreadsheets are a valid genre. See you Saturday around 3:45!

No worries at all — honestly, that's on me for not saying it sooner. Don't cover for it, you're right. Keeping it light and just a hangout is exactly what I want, so yes: if you nudge him, that's the way to do it. Thanks for being straight with me.
Thanks for taking it that way. No nudge needed — he's already in and it reads like a plain hangout, which is what it is. See you Saturday.
